text.en:
Except the territory consisting of the town proper or poblacion of the former municipality of
Isabela, which shall be known as the City of Basilan, the territory embracing the whole island of Basilan and
adjacent islands, in which are comprised the remaining barrios and sitios of the former municipality of Isabela
and the municipal districts of Lamitan and Maluso, which are hereby created into regular municipalities, is
constituted into a new province to be known as the Province of Basilan.
The capital of the province of Basilan shall be the municipality of Isabela.

Except as hereinafter provided, all provisions of law now or hereafter applicable to regular
provinces shall be applicable to the province of Basilan.

The present elective officials of the Province of Zamboanga del Sur shall perform their duties as
such officials in the newly created Province of Basilan until the officials of the latter shall have been duly
appointed by the President. Such officials thus appointed shall hold office until their successors shall have
been elected in the election for provincial and municipal officials following the issuance of this Decree and
shall have qualified unless sooner removed at the pleasure of the President. Other appointive officials and
employees as may be necessary to organize or to complete the government personnel of the province herein
created shall be appointed as provided by law.

The province herein created shall remain part of the present representative district of Zamboanga
del Sur until a law shall have been passed reapportioning the representative districts pursuant to Section 2,

of the Constitution.
Section 6. Upon the effectivity of this Decree, the proportionate share of the province of Basilan in the
obligations, funds, deposits and other properties of the City of Basilan shall be transferred by the President to
the province herein created upon the recommendation of the Chairman of the Commission on Audit.
Section 7. This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 27th day of December, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-three.
